Commentary.Commentary: That is it from us for this game! India have managed to clinch the series and in some fashion. Australia have not been up to the mark in this series and they would now hope to win the next two fixtures and salvage some pride. The next game will be played on the 28th of September in Bengaluru at 0800 GMT (1330 local time). Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Man of the Match, Hardik Pandya says that he would have liked to finish it off but is happy with his contribution. Mentions that a promotion up the order was not a surprise but an opportunity for him to do well. States that he wanted to target the left-arm spinner. Adds that he settled in and played the big shots. Feels that there is always a scope of improvement. Ends by saying that he wants to keep contributing with the ball as well.

Indian skipper, Virat Kohli says the wicket was really good to bat on. He admits it was a 330-340 wicket. He credits the bowlers for standing up when they wanted them to. Mentions the wrist spinners need to be backed and they will give you wickets. He reckons Australia were 25-30 runs short. Appreciates Hardik Pandya for his knock. Calls him a star and acknowledges that he was something they were missing - a strong hitter who can contribute with the ball. He informs the idea of promoting Pandya was of their coach Ravi Shastri. Ends by saying they might try some new players but the mindset remains the same.

Australian skipper, Steven Smith says that he thought that they set it up nicely but failed to finish their innings well. Credits the Indians bowlers for executing their plans. Feels that a score above 330 would have been good on this track. Adds that in contrast to India, his side did not execute their plans well with the ball. Praises India for their composed display with the bat especially Rohit, Rahane and Pandya. On their batting, mentions that they had a great platform. Credits Finch for his superb century. Ends by stating that they were not good enough in the slog overs and the pitch also slowed up a little.

The Australian bowling was flat and looked clueless. They had no answer to the brilliant batting display by the Indian top order. They did manage to provide a scare by picking a few quick wickets towards the end but it was never going to be enough. Also, their fielding was quite poor with Handscomb who is not their regular keeper dropping Rohit. Smith their captain dropping Pandya proved to be the turning point of the game. Earlier in the day, the visitors would also regret their middle order collapse which resulted in them posting a below par total. Stay tuned for the presentation.

What a victory for India! They now have won nine games in a row which is the joint-longest winning streak for them in ODIs. Take a bow Pandya! You can talk about the Kohlis, the Dhonis, but this young man is something else. He was promoted up the order and he not only played a brilliant game but ensured India were inches away from victory before he got out. Now coming back to the chase - the Indian team never looked in trouble due to the sublime opening partnership between Rohit Sharma and Ajinkya Rahane. Both scored a half century apiece but failed to kick on. They lost both of them in quick succession but Pandya along with Kohli and then Pandey ensured there were no further hiccups.

A terrific display from the Men in Blue and they have taken an unassailable 3-0 lead in the series! Pinpoint yorker on the boots, Pandey manages to dig it out off the inner half to short fine leg. A run taken. Customary handshakes all around. The Indian camp is elated! A thoroughly well-deserved victory. INDIA WIN BY 5 WICKETS WITH 13 BALLS TO SPARE.
Back of a length delivery on off, MS Dhoni swivels and helps it through square leg to rotate the strike. India need one more to win the game and the series.
Low full toss on middle and leg, Pandey whips it through square leg. Coulter-Nile races to his right and makes a good stop. A run taken. Dhoni is on strike and the crowd erupts!
Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, pulled to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Hit with a lot of power! Full length delivery outside off, Pandey clears his front leg and tonks it over mid off for a one-bounce boundary. India just one hit away from a win.
Kane Richardson returns for a bowl. This might be the last over of the match.
Landed on middle, played with soft hands towards mid on. Smith from short mid-wicket dives to his left to stop it.
Fullish on the boots, clipped to the same fielder again.
Spinning into Dhoni, tucked to mid-wicket.
Straying on the pads, helped to short fine leg for an easy run.
Floated outside off, Pandey mistimes his drives to mid off.
Slow through the air on off, Dhoni knocks it down to long on for a single.
Glenn Maxwell is into the attack.
Fullish delivery on the pads, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a run.
MS Dhoni walks out to bat. The crowd cheers for him loudly.

OUT! A brilliant knock from Pandya ends! He backed his ability and has brought his side to the brink of victory. Length delivery on off, Pandya looks to clear mid on but doesn't get the elevation he wanted. Richardson stationed in that region takes a comfortable catch. A wicket arrives for Australia but too late.
Wide! Angling down leg, Pandya moves inside the line and looks to clip it but misses.
Shortish delivery down the leg side, Pandya looks to help it to fine leg but gloves it towards Handscomb. He dives to his left to make a good stop.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Pandya looks to slog it across but misses.
Length delivery, defended off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, glided to third man for a run.
FOUR! Fullish delivery on middle and leg, Pandey slogs it through wide mid on for a rocketing boundary. 17 from the over already.
FOUR! Cheeky! Short delivery on off, Pandya ramps it over the keeper's head for another boundary.
Pandey skips down the track and Stoinis follows him with a short delivery. He taps it with a vertical bat to mid on for a run.
FOUR! India are racing towards a victory! Short delivery in line of the stumps, slower in pace. Pandey pulls it past short mid-wicket to find the fence.

FOUR! Length delivery around off, Pandey knows that there is no protection in the deep and goes for a heave. Drags it off the inner half over wide mid on for a boundary. Stoinis has a chat with Hardik but he doesn't pay any heed to it.
Fuller length delivery outside off, Pandey pushes at it but gets it off the outer half to third man. A single taken and he will retain the strike.
Slower one from Cummins. Pandya spots it and turns it to backward square leg for a single.
Shortish delivery well outside off, Pandey chops it through point for a run.
Length delivery outside off, steered to third man for a run.
Short of a length on off, Hardik hangs back and defends it nicely.
FOUR! Drilled! Fuller length delivery on off, Pandya shuffles a touch and drives it hard down the ground. He has timed it well and the ball races to the fence.
Shortish delivery on off, Pandey flat-bats it to mid on.

FOUR! Well played! Good length delivery outside off, Pandey clears his front leg and slaps it through covers. He has timed it well and he gets the desired result! 50-run stand comes up between the duo. It has come at a crucial stage.
Fullish delivery angling into Manish. Clipped to short mid-wicket.

Short delivery on off, shoots through after pitching. Pandey looks to pull it but he is not in a good position to do so. Ends up getting a top edge to fine leg. The fielder in the deep races to his right and slides to make a good save. Two runs taken.
Fullish delivery on off, driven sweetly to mid on.
Good length delivery on off, Pandya waits for it and eases it through mid on for a single. Sensible cricket from him.
Bowling change. Stoinis is called back for another spell.
Similar delivery outside off, Pandya steers it down to third man for a run.
On a length outside off, Pandya taps it behind point. Calls for a couple straightaway and completes it with ease in the end.
Full length delivery on off, Hardik drills it towards Cummins who sticks his right boot out to make a stop. Pandey dived back in his crease there.

FOUR! Another nervy moment but Pandya survives! Back of a length outside off, Pandya looks to force it through the covers but ends up getting a thick inside edge past the leg stump and through to the fence. Things are going India's way.
Length delivery outside off, Hardik drives it on the up to Smith at short cover. The skipper picks the ball up and mimes a throw at the bowler's end.
Back of a length delivery around off, Pandya plays it with an open bat face to point.
Pat Cummins is back for another burst. Can he get Pandya out?
A fraction short on off, Pandey makes use of the depth of the crease to block it. An expensive spell from Agar comes to an end. India need 51 runs from 54 balls.
Slow through the air, Pandya lunges forward in defense.
Flighted outside off, Hardik eases it through covers to rotate strike.
Flatter and quicker outside off, guided to short third man for a run.
Fullish on off, Pandya milks it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up on off, pushed to covers.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled by the umpire. Five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle.

An stifled appeal for an LBW denied! Shortish delivery on off and middle, skids through after pitching and also stays a bit low. Pandya looks to pull it across but is hit near his stomach and the ball rolls towards point. A leg bye taken.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot to short cover.
Straying on the hips, Hardik tucks it nicely through square leg for a brace.
Shortish delivery, Pandey flat-bats it to Head at short mid-wicket who fumbles to parry it to mid on. A run conceded.
Fuller in length on off, Pandya works it past Head at short mid-wicket. A run conceded.
Good length delivery on off, tapped back to the bowler.
Floated delivery, Manish lunges forward in defense.
Flatter delivery, punched to mid on.
Fullish on off, Pandya whips it to long on to rotate strike. That brings up his 4th ODI fifty. He has survived once but has continued with his natural game. Perhaps that is the way he thrives.
SIX! When he hits them, they stay hit! Tossed up on middle, Pandya skips down the track and bludgeons it over long on for a maximum. Australia need his wicket desperately.
Shortish around off, Pandey cuts it to sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up delivery, Manish prods forward to defend it watchfully.
Back of a length on off, tapped to covers.
Pandey goes for a heave to the fuller length delivery and drags it to wide mid on. A run taken.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Fractionally overpitched on off, Pandey drills it past the bowler for a rocketing boundary.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on the hips, Pandey swipes it through fine leg for a boundary.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back into the attack.

Dropped! Australia have dropped a few catches tonight and that is not helping their cause. Floated on off, Pandya looks to slog it down the ground but squirts it off the outer half over extra cover. Smith lines it up, backpedals but misjudges it a bit. He has to dive full length, gets a hand to it but the ball pops out and falls on the ground. How costly will this prove?
Flatter on off, punched to covers.
FOUR! Shot! Half-tracker on middle, Pandya pulls it over mid-wicket to find the fence.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
SIX! Bang! Shortish on middle and leg, Pandya pulls it over cow corner for a huge maximum. He plays his game no matter what the situation is.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Fullish outside off, driven to mid off. Back-to-back successful overs for the visitors.
Fullish delivery around off, eased to mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed to point.
Manish Pandey comes out to bat.

OUT! Soft dismissal! He didn't need to play such a stroke at this stage. Shortish delivery around off, Jadhav looks to cut it square of the wicket on the off side but only manages to get a faint nick. Handscomb behind the stumps who has had an ordinary day behind the stumps makes no mistake this time. India need run-a-ball with six wickets in hand.
Short delivery outside off, Pandya slaps it to deep point for a run. Cummins fumbles a touch and Pandya searches for the second. However, Jadhav sends him back.
Floated outside off, played to backward point. Productive over for Australia.

Rush of blood almost costs Jadhav his wicket! Tossed up on off, Jadhav dances down the track and goes for a slog but gets a thick inside edge. The ball goes past the stumps towards fine leg. Couple taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kedar Jadhav is the next man in. Still no Manish Pandey.

OUT! That's a big, big wicket! The chasemaster departs! Is it too late for Australia though? Floated on off, Kohli makes room and intends to go over extra cover. However, he ends up miscuing it towards wide long off. Finch stationed there bends and takes a good low catch to his left. The Indian skipper is disappointed, he was looking set to guide his side towards a victory. On the previous delivery, Agar's towel had fallen off before he bowled it. It was signaled a dead ball. If it hadn't been done so, the batsmen would have rotated strike.
Played with the angle to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle and leg, knocked down to long on for a single.
Scratch what I wrote. Ashton Agar is back into the attack.

Good length delivery well outside off, Hardik taps it behind point for a run. The throw is at the keeper's end and Pandya is interested for a second. However, Kohli sends him back rightly. No harm done.
Short delivery outside off, sticks a bit in the pitch. Pandya looks to ramp it over the keeper's head but misses.
Back of a length outside off and width on offer. Kohli slaps it to deep point for a run.
Good length delivery around off, Pandya places it to cover-point for a brisk single. 200 up for India and it is met with a huge cheer from the crowd.
Ashton Agar has his right hand taped. Not sure if he will bowl today.
Length delivery outside off, Kohli takes a couple of steps down the track to guide it to third man. A single taken.
Full length delivery on off, Virat drives it crisply to mid off.
Kane Richardson is back on.
Slower delivery outside off, Kohli steers it to third man for a run and will retain strike.
Fullish delivery on off, pushed off the front foot to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Hardik dabs it to the left of short third man for a single. That brings up the 50-run stand between the duo. It has been a sensible partnership.
Short delivery at a slower pace on middle. Kohli pulls it through in front of square for a run.
Angling into Kohli. He tucks it to mid-wicket.
Full length delivery outside off, Kohli caresses it to sweeper cover for a couple.

Time for Drinks. Though India have lost two wickets, they are still cruising along. Kohli and Pandya, who has been promoted the order are ticking along nicely. The hosts need 101 runs from 108 balls with eight wickets in hand. Australia need breakthroughs desperately if they are come back into the contest.
Good length outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man and takes an easy run.
Good length on off, shaping back in a touch. Kohli gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Captain leading from the front in the field! Fuller in length outside off, Pandya drives it hard towards covers. Smith dives to his right and makes a very good stop. He saves three for his side.
Slower ball outside off, Pandya make room and cuts it off the bottom edge to point.
Good length on off, Pandya drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length on off, Pandya drives it to mid off.
Almost drags it on! Stoinis bowls a short ball on off, Kohli tries to pull but gets a bottom edge which goes over the stumps and on the bounce to Handscomb.
Angles it on the pads, Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket.
Similar length on middle this time. Pandya drives it down to long on for an easy run. This is too easy for the Indians.
Lands it on a length outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man for a run.
Bangs in a short ball on off, Pandya swivels inside the crease and pulls it along the ground to square leg for a run.
Fuller in length on middle, Kohli clips it towards mid on and completes a run.
Slower ball outside off, Kohli waits for the ball and guides it down to third man for a run.
Good length on off, Kohli defends it off the front foot.
Shorter in length outside off, Pandya cuts it to point where the fielder fumbles and concedes a run.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Great work from Cummins! Coulter-Nile bowls it full on off, Kohli drives it towards covers. The ball bounces awkwardly, Cummins there does well to half stop it. The batsmen run through for a single.
A touch fuller in length on middle, Kohli walks across and tries to flick it through mid-wicket but gets a soft leading edge to mid on.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back into the attack. He already has one, Smith would want him to take one of these two out.
Lands it on a length on middle, Pandya pushes it back to the bowler.
Very slow short ball on middle, Kohli walks across and pulls it gently down to fine leg for a run.
Fullish ball on off, Kohli times his drive straight to the man at covers.
Fuller on middle, Pandya drives it down to long on for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Kohli goes for the drive but gets an outside edge through the vacant slip region and down to third man for a run.
Starts off his spell with a shorter ball on off, Pandya pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Marcus Stoinis is back into the attack.
FOUR! Majestic! That was sublime. Fuller in length by Cummins on off. Kohli leans into it and drives it through the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
Fuller in length around off, Pandya drives it towards mid off for a run.
Lands it on a length outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man for a run.
Fuller in length on leg stump. Pandya flicks it stylishly towards deep mid-wicket for a run. Cummins has some words to say to Hardik as he walks back to his bowling mark.
Cummins goes wide of the crease and angles it into the pads. Kohli clips it through backward square leg for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Kohli drives it straight to the man at covers.

Things heating up in the middle. Handscomb has a chat with the umpires. He had exchanged some words with Pandya and it might be regarding that. Marais Erasmus goes to Pandya and has a conversation with him.
Drags his length back outside off. Kohli cuts it through point for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fires it on leg stump. Pandya drives it towards mid on. Maxwell at short mid-wicket does well to dive to his left and stop the ball.
Flatter on off, Kohli taps it in front of covers for a quick run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
SIX! BOOM! Another one by Pandya! Agar has not learnt from his mistake in the last over. He bowls it full on middle this time. Pandya tonks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Pure class! Cummins errs in line and bowls it on the leg stump. Kohli is too good to miss out on that. He flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Fuller in length on off, Pandya drives it through covers for a run.

Comes steaming in and bowls it on off and angling into the batsman. Pandya misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The Australians appeal but nothing from the umpire. Steven Smith thinks about a review but Handscomb indicates it is going down leg and they opt not to take it.

Uppish but safe! Cummins bowls it a touch full on off, Pandya drives it uppishly but on the bounce to the man at covers. There is some banter between Cummins and Pandya. Pat maybe wants to get into the head of Hardik here.
Tad fuller on off, Pandya drives it on the up to the man at covers.
Lands it on a length on off, Pandya guides it to point.
Plays it with the angle towards mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls an arm ball on leg stump, Kohli camps back and punches it down the ground for a run.
Drags his length back outside off. Kohli cuts it to point.
Shorter in length on middle, Hardik punches it down to long on for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! You toss it up to him and he will go after you. Agar floats it on middle, Pandya sees the flight and goes over wide long on for a maximum. He won't be tossing it up again.
There is some discussion going on between the Australians and the umpires. Not quite sure what the reason is.
Good length on off, Pandya gets an outside egde down to third man for a run.
Lands it on a length around off, Pandya guides it to point.
Fuller in length on off, inviting Pandya for a drive. Pandya obliges and hits it to short cover.
Surprise, surprise! It is Hardik Pandya who walks in at No. 4.

OUT! There goes another one! Rahane departs now after playing a wonderful innings. The bowling change has worked wonders. Cummins comes running in and lands it on a length on off, the ball stays a touch low. Rahane tries to flick but is beaten by the low bounce and is struck on the pads. The Australians appeal and the umpire raises his finger. That looked plumb. Cummins is all pumped. Australia have a sniff over here after a couple of quick wickets.
Almost an edge! Cummins lands it on a length outside off. Rahane tries to guide it down to third man but gets beaten.
Lands it on a length around middle, Rahane flicks it through backward square leg for a couple.
Pat Cummins comes back into the attack.
Bowls an arm ball on middle. Kohli defends it off the front foot.
Flicks it on the leg side for a run with the angle.
Floats it on off, Rahane drives it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on off, Kohli drives it down to long off for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Flatter on middle, Kohli punches it down to long on for a run.
Good news for Australia! Ashton Agar is back on the field and he is straightaway going to bowl.
Fuller in length on off, Rahane drives it to mid off.
Angles it on the pads, Rahane flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Virat Kohli is the next man in.

OUT! Coulter-Nile strikes! Australia needed this wicket. He bowls it short on middle, the ball skids off the surface. Rohit tries to pull but gets a top edge as he is late on it, towards deep mid-wicket. Hilton Cartwright, the substitute fielder stationed there gets under the ball and takes it comfortably. A brilliant innings by Rohit comes to an end. Can the visitors build on this wicket now? India need another 155 from 170 balls.
Lands it on a length outside off, Rahane guides it down to third man for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

FOUR! Almost a catch there back to the bowler but instead it goes to the boundary. Coulter-Nile lands it on a length on off, the ball stops a touch. Rahane closes the face of his bat early and it goes off the leading edge, uppishly past the bowler and the ball races to the fence.
Guides the ball down to third man for a run.
Rahane comes down the track to the length ball on off and hits it hard to mid off. He could not quite find the gap there.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lands it on a length on middle, Rahane works it to mid on.
Angles it into the batsman. Rahane flicks it to the right of mid-wicket. The fielder there makes a good diving stop to prevent a single.
Back of a length outside off, Sharma punches it through covers for a run.

FOUR! Rahane is on the charge now! The bowler bowls it short on middle, it sits up to be hit. Rahane camps back and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. That went like a tracer bullet.
Back of a length around off, Sharma drives it through covers for a run.
Shortish length on leg stump. Rahane shuffles across and tries to flick but fails to do so. The ball takes the pad and goes down to fine leg for a leg bye.
Tad shorter outside off, Rahane times it beautifully to point.
Good length on off, Ajinkya defends it off the front foot.
Fuller in length on off, Rahane drives it to mid off.
Good length on off, Sharma defends it off the front foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

In the air... but safe! A good effort in the deep by Cummins. Shorter in length on off by Richardson. Rohit pulls it uppishly towards the mid-wicket boundary. Cummins in the deep runs to his left and does well to push the ball back in. They go upstairs to check and he has done fine there. Two runs taken by the batsmen.
Sprays it on the pads, Rahane shuffles across and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Shorter in length on off, Rahane shuffles across and pulls it through backward square leg for a couple.
Back of a length on off, Rahane off the back foot plays it towards point.
Kane Richardson comes back into the attack.
Again bowls it from wide of the crease and lands it on a length on off. The ball nips back in a touch. Rohit off the front foot guides it to point.
Lands it on off, angling into the batsman. Rohit guides it to point.
Goes wide of the crease and lands it on a length outside off, Ajinkya drives it through covers for a run.
Good length on off, Rahane defends it towards point.
STAT ALERT - This is the first time since Nagpur, 2013 where India�s openers have both scored a fifty in an ODI chase against Australia.
FOUR! Fifty up for Rahane now. His 21st in ODIs. These two are going along their merry way here. Coulter-Nile drifts it down the leg side, Rahane flicks it through fine leg for a boundary.
Comes running in and bowls it on a length on middle. Rahane drives it to mid on.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back into the attack.
Drinks! India are cruising at the moment. Rohit Sharma is showcasing a batting masterclass out there. Australia are in a desperate need of a wicket. India need another 178 runs from 33 overs.

Dropped! The woes continue for Australia. Good length delivery outside off, Sharma aims to guide it to third man but gets a thick outside edge. Handscomb behind the wickets dives full length to his right, gets his right glove to it but fails to hold on. The ploy to go with a part time wicket keeper is not working for Australia. Peter has struggled. Rohit has already been put down twice. The visitors can't afford it, especially when he is in such rich vein of form.
Good length delivery outside off at 147 clicks, Rahane steers it to third man for a run.
On a length around the hips, tucked through mid-wicket for a run.
Oh dear! Ashton Agar has just hurt his little finger of his bowling hand. Not good signs here. He is in a lot of pain and he is walking off the field. Hilton Cartwright comes as his substitute.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Shortish in line of the stumps, Sharma pulls it in a controlled manner through in front of square leg. Agar from deep mid-wicket hares to his right, slides but fails to prevent the boundary. He seems to have done damage to his right hand, perhaps has split his webbing.
FOUR! No better place to hit a ball than down the ground. Fullish in length on off, Sharma leans ahead and lifts it straight as an arrow to pick up another boundary.
Length delivery on middle, patted back to the bowler.
Pat Cummins returns for a burst. Australia desperately need a wicket.
Slower one again outside off, eased to covers.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Back of a length ball around the hips, Rahane swivels a touch and swipes it through backward square leg for a rocketing boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Rahane punches it to Agar at mid on who slides to stop it. He was looking for the run but is sent back by Sharma.
Slower delivery on the boots, Sharma plays it with soft hands through mid-wicket for an easy single.
On a length in line of the stumps, Ajinkya works it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid on.
Marcus Stoinis is back into the attack.
Straying on the pads, flicked in front of square leg for a run. 100 up for India in 15 overs. Easy going!

FOUR! Hit powerfully! A bit short on off, Rahane rocks back and pulls it uppishly towards Maxwell at short mid-wicket. He leaps to his right but the ball goes past him in a flash and through to the fence.
Flighted delivery, Rahane lunges forward in defense.
Tossed up outside off, eased to long off for a single.
Clipped with the angle to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Shot! Fraction short around off, spinning away. Sharma cuts it through point. Coulter-Nile in the deep runs to his left, dives full length but fails to prevent the boundary. He landed awkwardly and holds his head in pain. Thankfully, he is alright.
Fullish on middle and leg, Rohit milks it down to long on for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Short delivery, angling in. Rahane pulls it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Sharma aims to go inside out over covers but miscues it. A single taken.
Shortish and room on offer, Ajinkya cuts it to deep point for a run.
Back of a length outside off, Rahane punches it through covers. Cummins in the deep races to his right and slides to stop it. Saves a couple for his side.

SIX! Boom! Tossed up delivery in line of the stumps, Sharma is nimble on his feet and smokes it over long on for a biggie. That brings up his 33rd ODI fifty, his fastest. It has been a flawless knock from him. Australia need to get him out quickly or else, they will find it really difficult to come back into the contest.
A bit wide of off this time, once again driven to the left of Agar who dives to deny a run.
Floated on off, driven to the left of Agar who does well to stop it.
Drifting towards the pads, helped through square leg to rotate strike.
Floated on off, Rahane lunges forward in defense.
Slow through the air on off, pushed off the front foot to Smith at short cover.
Shortish delivery on off, Rahane pulls it all along the ground to deep square leg for a run.
Full length delivery outside off, eased to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish in line of the stumps, Rohit drives it to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, Rohit guides it to Maxwell at backward point. Shouts no for the single.
Shortish delivery on middle, Rahane moves inside the line to tuck it through square leg. A single taken.
Fullish delivery outside off, Rahane looks to drive it on the up but is beaten due to the lack of bounce on it.
Kane Richardson is back on. Smith is shuffling around his bowlers in search of a wicket.
Rahane works this one to short fine leg for a run and will retain the strike.
Floated on off, Sharma milks it down to long off for a single.
Tossed up around off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Fullish on the pads, clipped gently to mid-wicket for an easy run.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
STAT ALERT - This is the first time Rahane & Rohit have put on fifty-plus for the opening stand in ODIs.

Around off, Sharma places it with the spin through point. Rahane is a bit hesitant for the second but Sharma calls him through. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but the batsman is easily in.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Maximum of four fielders will be allowed the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Time for some spin now. Ashton Agar is introduced into the attack.
Fullish on off, driven crisply back to the bowler. India are cruising at the moment.
FOUR! Well placed! Back of a length outside off, Rahane guides it through the gap between short third man and backward point to get another boundary to his name.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Good length delivery on the hips, Rahane tucks it over backward square leg and the ball races to the fence.
Fuller in length outside off, slower in place. Rahane is early into his drive and gets beaten.

FOUR! Not convincing but he will take it! Ajinkya skips down the track to a length delivery on off, aims to hit it over mid on but gets it off the inner half past short mid-wicket. A boundary results. Rahane looks much better when he plays conventional strokes.
Angling into the hips, Sharma clips it to short fine leg for a brisk single.
Back of a length outside off, Sharma guides it to short third man and sets off. The fielder makes a good stop. He has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Length delivery on middle and leg, nudged to square leg for a run.
Slower one on middle, well bowled. Sharma knocks it down to long on for a run.

SIX! Into the Orbit! Such power in that hit that it has traveled 103 meters. Sharma shimmies a touch and Richardson opts to bowl a short ball on middle and leg. It sits up nicely for Sharma. He pulls it with aplomb over deep backward square leg for a huge maximum. That has gone out of the ground. Fetch another ball, umpires.
Back of a length outside off, punched nicely to extra cover.
Richardson goes wide of the crease and angles it on a fullish length on middle and leg. Sharma offers a straight bat to time it nicely to mid on.
Short and width on offer. Ajinkya slaps it towards deep point. Agar runs across from sweeper cover, bends and makes a good stop. Saves a couple for his side.
A bit uppish but safe! Fuller in length outside off, sticks a bit in the pitch. As a result, Rahane mistimes it but luckily for him, it falls short of Smith at cover-point.
Short of a length outside off, Rahane hangs back and places it to backward point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length on middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a run this time.
Angling into Rahane. Clipped towards square leg for a run.
Marcus Stoinis comes for a bowl.
Length delivery outside off, played with an angled bat to point.
FOUR! Sheer class! Fraction short on off, Sharma in his customary manner presses forward and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, turned to mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, eased to mid off.

Dropped and Four! A very tough chance to be honest! Shortish and room on offer, Sharma cuts it fiercely towards Maxwell at backward point. He dives full length to his left, gets a hand to it but the ball bursts through. Sharma picks up another boundary.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma punches it elegantly but straight to Smith at cover-point. Sunil Gavaskar on-air mentions that the margin for error is really less with Sharma in such kind of form.
Kane Richardson comes into the attack. He did a good job in the last game and the same will be expected from him tonight.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to third man for a run.

SIX! This is  special! What clean hitting from the elegant opener. Fullish delivery on off, Sharma leans ahead and lifts it over long off. He has timed that so well and the ball clears the fence with ease. Ominous signs for Australia.
On a length in line of the stumps, defended solidly off the back foot.
Fullish delivery on off, Sharma eases it to short cover.

FOUR! Timing at its best! Fuller in length on the pads, Sharma clips it nonchalantly through mid-wicket and the ball whistles away to the boundary. Michael Clarke on-air says that Rohit makes batting look so easy when he plays such shots.
Full length delivery, Sharma shuffles a touch and drives it to wide mid on.
On middle and leg this time, Rohit turns it through backward square leg for a run and will retain the strike.
Fuller length delivery on middle, Sharma times it sweetly but straight to Cummins.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

SIX! What a shot! Cummins opt to bowl a short delivery on off at 145 clicks, Sharma transfers his weight on the front foot and pulls it with authority over deep backward square leg for a mammoth maximum. That was so well timed, a delight to watch when he plays such shots.
Angling down leg, Rahane works it to deep backward square leg. A run taken.
On a length on off, Rahane shuffles a touch and defends it to mid on. The Australian bowlers have more or less been disciplined till now.
Leg bye! Straying on the leg stump, Rahane looks to clip it away but is struck on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batsmen take a run.

Back of a length around off, Sharma looks to guide it to third man but gets a little bat to it as the ball rolls towards point. Sharma calls for the run and his partner responds. Maxwell is quick to it but not quick enough.
Good length ball outside off, glided to third man for a run.

FOUR! Aggression from Rahane! Cross-seam delivery from Coulter-Nile on a good length around off. Ajinkya skips down the track and goes inside out over covers to find the fence. First boundary of the innings.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Length delivery on off, Rahane works it to mid-wicket.
Fullish on middle, Rahane turns it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short of a length outside off, stays low. Rahane looks to cut but misses.
Fullish delivery, Rahane drives it to mid on.
Similar length ball outside off, dabbed to backward point.

Back of a length outside off, Rahane places it to Smith at cover-point. He picks it up and throws it towards Stoinis at mid on. He fails to stop it. The batsmen run a couple in the process. However, the umpires engage in a conversation and decide to disallow the runs. The reason was that the ball was already dead.
Length delivery on off, Rahane covers the line and defends it stoutly.
Length delivery outside off, holding its line. Rohit plants his front foot across to allow it through.
Short delivery on leg stump, comes at a nice height to Ajinkya. He pulls it all along the ground to Cummins at deep backward square leg. A single taken.

Two Wides! Slips this one down the leg side, Sharma fails to clip it through. The bounce is low as Handscomb bends to his left to collect it but doesn't do it cleanly. The batsmen sneak in another extra run.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit camps back and punches it to short cover.
Full length delivery on off, Sharma allows it to come to him and taps it with an open bat face to point.
Angling into Ajinkya. He turns it to wide mid on for a single.
Fuller in length on middle and off, Sharma is opened up in his stance and gets an outside edge to third man. A run taken.
Nathan Coulter-Nile to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. A slip in place for him.

Almost chopped it on! On a length in the zone of apprehension, stays a bit low. Sharma hops to block it but gets a thick inside edge past his leg stump. Rahane calls him through for a run. Agar hares across to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Steady start from Cummins.
Fractionally overpitched around off, Sharma drives it crisply back towards Cummins who does well to crouch and stop it.
Fullish delivery angling into Rohit. He shuffles a touch and clips it nicely to short mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball outside off, Sharma lunges forward confidently and defends it solidly.
India are away! Good length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Rahane guides it with an angled blade past the gully fielder for a run.
Good start from Cummins! Length delivery on middle, a bit of away swing on offer. Rahane gets squared up a touch and defends it.

We are back for the chase. Out come the men who matter to the middle. Rohit Sharma and Ajinkya Rahane to open the batting for India. Pat Cummins to take the first new ball for Australia. Two slips in place. Here we go...
